{
  "IP": "neorv32_cpu_icc",
  "Conceptual Assets": [
    {
      "Concept ID": "C1",
      "Concept Name": "CSR access command",
      "Unit": "neorv32_cpu_icc",
      "Information": "The CSR write/read strobes and address determine whether an access occurs, its direction, and which communication register or status path it reaches. The IP depends on this command to enqueue transmit data, acknowledge accesses, and select returned data or status.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "no",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"
      },
      "Rubric Reason": "The command gates communication activity: line 60 generates the FIFO write enable and line 59 generates the transmit acknowledgement, so blocking or altering the command can withhold enqueue or access service.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "An attacker could suppress or alter the CSR write/read strobes or address so transmit data is not queued or communication accesses are not acknowledged.",
      "Enters Through": [
        "csr_we_i",
        "csr_re_i",
        "csr_addr_i"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [],
      "Entry Lines": [
        46,
        47,
        59,
        60
      ],
      "Held Lines": [
        46,
        47,
        59,
        60
      ],
      "Exit Lines": []
    }
  ],
  "Not Kept": [
    {
      "Candidate Name": "ICC transfer payload",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cpu_icc",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The words are only relayed between ports and the FIFO at lines 52, 81, and 86, with no statement of this unit storing or computing them; Forwarded transactions and Transfer records exclude relayed data as a separate concept."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "ICC transfer handshake",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cpu_icc",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The ready and acknowledge fields only qualify, consume, or report transfer data at lines 48, 51, 59, 85, and 87, so Transfer records treats them as part of the transfer rather than an independent asset."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Transmit FIFO availability status",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cpu_icc",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The FIFO free/ready information is only reported through lines 49, 83, and 87; the RTL shows no secrecy requirement, immutable-sensitive state, or use by this unit to gate operation, so it fails the asset test."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "CSR read-back payload and status",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cpu_icc",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The read-back at lines 48, 49, and 52 consists only of relayed ICC data and FIFO/transfer status, which are excluded by the relayed-data and buffer-status rules rather than being information held by this unit."
    }
  ],
  "Notes": []
}

conceptual assets.information: The CSR write/read strobes and address determine whether an access occurs, its direction, and which communication register or status path it reaches. The IP depends on this command to enqueue transmit data, acknowledge accesses, and select returned data or status.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The command gates communication activity: line 60 generates the FIFO write enable and line 59 generates the transmit acknowledgement, so blocking or altering the command can withhold enqueue or access service.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could suppress or alter the CSR write/read strobes or address so transmit data is not queued or communication accesses are not acknowledged.

considered, not kept.reason: The words are only relayed between ports and the FIFO at lines 52, 81, and 86, with no statement of this unit storing or computing them; Forwarded transactions and Transfer records exclude relayed data as a separate concept.

The ready and acknowledge fields only qualify, consume, or report transfer data at lines 48, 51, 59, 85, and 87, so Transfer records treats them as part of the transfer rather than an independent asset.

The FIFO free/ready information is only reported through lines 49, 83, and 87; the RTL shows no secrecy requirement, immutable-sensitive state, or use by this unit to gate operation, so it fails the asset test.

The read-back at lines 48, 49, and 52 consists only of relayed ICC data and FIFO/transfer status, which are excluded by the relayed-data and buffer-status rules rather than being information held by this unit.
